claims: LACR separately constructs a skeleton and orients edges using background knowledge, retrieved documents and optional PC output.
The prompt has an UNKNOWN response; unusable knowledge sources are discarded in aggregation.
Reported retrieval effects differ by benchmark: ASIA skeleton F1 falls from 1 to 0.73 with documents; CORONARY improves; adding PC output reduces SACHS F1 to 0.46.

anchors.section: Sections 3.2.1–3.2.3: conditional associations, mapping and aggregation
Sections 4.3.1–4.3.3: ASIA, CORONARY and SACHS results

adverse_findings_and_limits: The formal mapping from knowledge-base answers to an edge decision does not establish that those answers faithfully represent the target population.
Orientation accuracy is evaluated on recovered true-positive edges; it is not full-graph accuracy or effect uncertainty.
Authors question benchmark graph truth; revised labels require independent justification rather than rescoring after inspecting a method.
source_record.project_disposition: Retain retrieval and source-level abstention as candidates; register adverse-document and wrong-domain ablations.

source_record.title: Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations
source_record.local_path: docs/papers/Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations Zhang(2026).pdf
source_record.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: ARGUS audits reported evidence for DiD identifying assumptions and explicitly does not adjudicate causal truth.
The synthetic flaw study shows a retrieval/abstention trade-off: its gated pipeline misses some omissions that ungated ablations flag.
In the small five-paper human-label pilot, weak retrieval produces excessive severity; the reported calibration adjustment is in-sample and untested on unseen papers.
source_record.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.

anchors.section: Human-label pilot, in-sample calibration and discussion

adverse_findings_and_limits: Failure to retrieve evidence is different from absence of evidence in the paper.
Synthetic flaw injection, a general-economics corpus and a small reconciled pilot do not establish climate-policy or bank validation.
High agreement with majority medium labels can mask poor discrimination; author-reported improvements are not external review.
source_record.project_disposition: Candidate evidence-audit pattern with retrieval status distinct from scientific risk, and expert adjudication retained.
